# Starbase Spooky

Original game by Andrew Wooldridge (triptych), 2026. The game includes eight original rooms, five days of story, space quizzes, repairs and the station mystery. Original WebP artwork generated using fal and MP3 music, effects and voices generated using ElevenLabs, as described in the upstream art and audio notes bundled in src/dev/. Local changes include pureTV input, focus, suspension and packaging. The original MIT license is reproduced below.

https://github.com/triptych/web-games-andrew/tree/a7051c34fe2e7550fd206e6272f758df171855b0/game-130
